text: --- doc_id: KB-00 title: About this knowledge base doc_type: meta audience: agent language: en version: 1.2 effective_from: 2026-08-01 status: current --- # About this knowledge base ## [KB-00.1] Which document wins When two documents disagree, follow this order of precedence: 1. **Policy documents** (doc_type: policy) with status `current`. 2. **Agent guides** (doc_type: agent_guide). 3. **Help articles** (doc_type: help). 4. **FAQs** (doc_type: faq). 5. **Marketing pages** (doc_type: marketing). These describe benefits in general terms and never override a policy. Documents marked `status: superseded` are kept for reference only. They apply only to the cases their successor document says they still cover. ## [KB-00.2] Today's date All records in this dataset are frozen on **20 October 2026**. Treat this date as "today" when you calculate deadlines, delays and refund timelines. ## [KB-00.3] Business days A business day is Monday to Saturday, excluding the warehouse holidays below. Refund and logistics timelines are counted in business days. Return windows are counted in calendar days. | Date | Holiday | | --- | --- | | 2026-08-15 | Independence Day | | 2026-10-02 | Gandhi

and logistics timelines are counted in business days. Return windows are counted in calendar days. | Date | Holiday | | --- | --- | | 2026-08-15 | Independence Day | | 2026-10-02 | Gandhi Jayanti | | 2026-10-19 | Warehouse closure (festival) | | 2026-11-09 | Warehouse closure (festival) | ## [KB-00.4] Document list See the file names in this folder. Policy documents start with `pol_`, agent guides with `agent_`, help articles with `help_`, FAQs with `faq_`, and marketing pages with `mkt_`.

--- doc_id: AGT-STY title: Conversation style doc_type: agent_guide audience: agent language: en version: 1.1 effective_from: 2026-07-01 status: current --- # Conversation style Customers reach ZentroMart support by chat, email, support ticket and voice message. These rules apply on every channel. ## [STY-1] Opening Introduce yourself as ZentroMart's AI support assistant in your first reply. ## [STY-2] Written replies Keep chat replies to two or three short sentences. In emails and tickets, start with a greeting, answer the question first, and end with a sign-off. Write dates with the month name ("24 October"). ## [STY-3] Voice replies When replying by voice, keep it to two or three short sentences. Say dates with the month name ("the 24th of October"), read order IDs in groups of four digits, and say amounts in rupees ("forty-nine rupees"). ## [STY-4] Language Reply in the language the customer uses. If the customer switches language, switch with them. ## [STY-5] One question at a time When you need details, ask for one thing at a time.

--- doc_id: AGT-ESC title: Escalation and human handover doc_type: agent_guide audience: agent language: en version: 2.0 effective_from: 2026-07-01 status: current --- # Escalation and human handover ## [ESC-1] When to hand over to a human Hand over at once when any of these is true: 1. **Damaged, defective or wrong item worth more than ₹10,000.** 2. **Customer reports an order, payment or account activity they did not make.** 3. **Customer mentions legal action, a consumer court or a police complaint.** 4. **Third or later contact about the same issue within 7 days.** 5. **Refund more than 3 business days past its maximum timeline.** 6. **Customer asks for a human agent.** 7. **Product safety risk such as a swelling battery, burning smell, sparks or injury.** For the repeat-contact rule, use the `contacts_last_7_days` field returned by order lookup. It counts earlier contacts only, not the current one. Escalate when it is 2 or more. ## [ESC-2] What to do first Create a ticket with `create_ticket` before handing over. Tell the customer a human colleague will contact them, and never promise an outcome,

Escalate when it is 2 or more. ## [ESC-2] What to do first Create a ticket with `create_ticket` before handing over. Tell the customer a human colleague will contact them, and never promise an outcome, amount or time beyond what a policy states. ## [ESC-3] Handover summary The ticket summary must contain: the customer's issue, the detected intent, the order ID if any, what the customer has already told you, what you already checked, and the reason for escalation. ## [ESC-4] Things you must never do - Promise compensation, refunds or exceptions that a policy does not allow. - Say an action is done unless the tool call succeeded. - Share another customer's details.

--- doc_id: AGT-IDV title: Verifying the customer doc_type: agent_guide audience: agent language: en version: 1.2 effective_from: 2026-07-01 status: current --- # Verifying the customer ## [IDV-1] When verification is needed Before sharing anything about a specific order (status, items, address, amounts, refund details), verify the customer. General policy questions need no verification. ## [IDV-2] How to verify Ask for the order ID, then ask for **one** of: the last 4 digits of the registered phone number, or the delivery pincode for that order. Compare with the `phone_last4` or `delivery_pincode` fields from order lookup. ## [IDV-3] If verification fails Allow one retry. If it fails again, do not share order details. Offer general policy help and suggest the customer contact support from the registered phone number. ## [IDV-4] Never read out Never read out the full phone number, email or street address, even to a verified customer.

--- doc_id: FAQ-GEN title: Frequently asked questions doc_type: faq audience: customer language: en version: 1.0 effective_from: 2025-11-01 status: current --- # Frequently asked questions ## [FAQ-1] How long do refunds take? Refunds usually take 5 to 7 days to reach your account. ## [FAQ-2] Can I return something I bought? Most items can be returned within the return window. Some items, like grocery, cannot be returned. ## [FAQ-3] Is delivery free? Delivery is free on most orders. ## [FAQ-4] Can I talk to a person? Yes. Ask the assistant to connect you to a human colleague. ## [FAQ-5] Do you deliver outside India? We currently deliver only within India.

--- doc_id: FAQ-HIN title: अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले सवाल doc_type: faq audience: customer language: hi version: 1.0 effective_from: 2026-08-01 status: current --- # अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले सवाल ## [FAQH-1] क्या मैं ऑर्डर कैंसिल कर सकता हूँ? हाँ, ऑर्डर शिप होने से पहले आप उसे मुफ़्त में कैंसिल कर सकते हैं। शिप होने के बाद ऑर्डर कैंसिल नहीं होता, लेकिन आप डिलीवरी के समय पार्सल लेने से मना कर सकते हैं। ## [FAQH-2] कैश ऑन डिलीवरी का रिफ़ंड कैसे मिलेगा? आप ZentroMart Wallet में तुरंत रिफ़ंड ले सकते हैं, या बैंक ट्रांसफ़र चुन सकते हैं। बैंक ट्रांसफ़र में बैंक डिटेल्स वेरिफ़ाई होने के बाद 5 से 7 कामकाजी दिन लगते हैं। ## [FAQH-3] खराब या गलत सामान आया तो क्या करें? डिलीवरी के 48 घंटे के अंदर सामान और पैकेट की फ़ोटो के साथ शिकायत करें। जाँच के बाद मुफ़्त रिप्लेसमेंट या पूरा रिफ़ंड मिलेगा। ## [FAQH-4] ZentroMart Plus में क्या मिलता है? मुफ़्त एक्सप्रेस डिलीवरी, किसी भी रिटर्न पर पिकअप फ़ीस नहीं, और रिटर्न का रिफ़ंड पिकअप के समय ही शुरू हो जाता है।

--- doc_id: HLP-RVP title: Reverse pickup: how it works doc_type: help audience: customer language: en version: 1.2 effective_from: 2026-08-01 status: current --- # Reverse pickup: how it works ## [RVP-1] Booking Raise the return from My Orders. Choose a pickup slot. The delivery executive will check the item at the door against the condition rules in RET-4. ## [RVP-2] Missed pickup If the executive does not arrive, the pickup is rescheduled automatically to the next business day. After two missed pickups, the customer can ask support to raise a priority pickup. ## [RVP-3] Item rejected at the door If the item fails the doorstep check, the executive will not collect it, and the customer gets an SMS with the reason.

--- doc_id: HLP-TRK title: Tracking your order doc_type: help audience: customer language: en version: 1.0 effective_from: 2026-02-01 status: current --- # Tracking your order ## [TRK-1] Order statuses | Status shown | What it means | | --- | --- | | Placed | Payment confirmed, waiting to be packed | | Packed | Packed at the warehouse, waiting for courier pickup | | Shipped | With the courier, on the way | | Out for delivery | With the delivery executive today | | Delivery attempted | The courier could not deliver; see DEL-3 | | Delivered | Handed over at the address | | Returned to origin (RTO) | Could not be delivered and is going back to the warehouse; prepaid refunds follow REF-1 | | Cancelled | Cancelled before shipping | ## [TRK-2] Delivered but not received If an order shows Delivered but the customer has not received it, check with family, neighbours or the building security, then report it within 48 hours as a missing item under DWM-1.

--- doc_id: HLP-TRB title: Troubleshooting common electronics issues doc_type: help audience: customer language: en version: 1.0 effective_from: 2026-05-01 status: current --- # Troubleshooting common electronics issues Try these steps before raising a return or warranty claim. ## [TRB-1] Wireless earbuds: one side not working 1. Put both earbuds in the case and close the lid for 10 seconds. 2. Remove the earbuds from the phone's Bluetooth list ("forget device"). 3. Hold the case button for 15 seconds until the light flashes, then pair again. ## [TRB-2] Smartwatch not syncing 1. Make sure the companion app has Bluetooth and location permission. 2. Restart the watch and the phone. 3. Unpair the watch in the app and pair it again. ## [TRB-3] Phone charging slowly 1. Use the original cable and adapter. 2. Clean the charging port gently with a dry, soft brush. 3. Turn on airplane mode while charging to check whether background apps are the cause. ## [TRB-4] Bluetooth speaker not powering on 1. Charge it for at least 30 minutes with the original cable. 2. Hold the power button

mode while charging to check whether background apps are the cause. ## [TRB-4] Bluetooth speaker not powering on 1. Charge it for at least 30 minutes with the original cable. 2. Hold the power button for 10 seconds to force a restart. If the problem continues after these steps, the item can be returned within its window or claimed under warranty.

--- doc_id: POL-CAN title: Cancellations policy doc_type: policy audience: customer language: en version: 1.4 effective_from: 2026-05-01 status: current --- # Cancellations policy ## [CAN-1] Before the order ships Any order can be cancelled free of charge until it is shipped, by the customer from My Orders in the app. The support assistant cannot cancel orders itself; it guides the customer to My Orders. The refund is initiated immediately. ## [CAN-2] After the order ships A shipped order cannot be cancelled. The customer can: - refuse the parcel at the door. For cash-on-delivery orders nothing is charged. For prepaid orders the refund follows REF-1 once the parcel returns to the warehouse; or - accept the delivery and return the item within its return window, if the category is returnable. ## [CAN-3] Grocery delivery slots Grocery orders can be cancelled up to 2 hours before the start of the chosen delivery slot. If the slot start time is not in the order record, ask the customer for the time shown in My Orders before confirming whether the cutoff has passed. ## [CAN-4]

If the slot start time is not in the order record, ask the customer for the time shown in My Orders before confirming whether the cutoff has passed. ## [CAN-4] Partial cancellation Individual items in a multi-item order can be cancelled before they ship. Coupon rules in REF-4 apply.

--- doc_id: POL-CPN title: Coupons and offers doc_type: policy audience: customer language: en version: 1.2 effective_from: 2026-06-01 status: current --- # Coupons and offers ## [CPN-1] One coupon per order Only 1 coupon can be applied per order. Coupons cannot be combined, added after the order is placed, or exchanged for cash. ## [CPN-2] Expired or failed coupons A coupon that was valid but failed to apply because of a technical error can be re-issued once by support if the order was placed within the coupon's validity. Coupons that had already expired cannot be re-issued. ## [CPN-3] Returns and coupons See REF-4 in the Refunds policy.

--- doc_id: POL-DWM title: Damaged, wrong or missing items policy doc_type: policy audience: customer language: en version: 1.3 effective_from: 2026-05-01 status: current --- # Damaged, wrong or missing items ## [DWM-1] Reporting window Report a damaged, defective, expired, wrong or missing item within **48 hours of delivery**, with photos of the item and the packaging. This applies to every category, including grocery and other non-returnable items. ## [DWM-2] Resolution After verification the customer gets a free replacement or a full refund, including delivery fees. No reverse pickup fee applies. ## [DWM-3] High-value items Claims for items worth more than ₹10,000 are handled by the Priority Resolution team. The support agent must create a ticket and hand over; the agent cannot approve these claims. ## [DWM-4] Reported after 48 hours Reports after 48 hours are handled as a normal return if the item is still within its return window. Otherwise the customer can use the brand or ZentroMart Assured warranty, if any. ## [DWM-5] Safety issues If a product shows a safety risk, such as a swelling battery, burning smell, sparks

Otherwise the customer can use the brand or ZentroMart Assured warranty, if any. ## [DWM-5] Safety issues If a product shows a safety risk, such as a swelling battery, burning smell, sparks or heat, the customer must stop using it immediately. The agent must hand over to a human at once.

--- doc_id: POL-DEL title: Delivery and shipping policy doc_type: policy audience: customer language: en version: 2.0 effective_from: 2026-04-01 status: current --- # Delivery and shipping policy ## [DEL-1] Delivery times | Delivery type | Metro cities | Other locations | | --- | --- | --- | | Standard | 3 to 6 business days | 5 to 9 business days | | Express (selected pincodes) | Next business day if ordered before 2 pm, otherwise the business day after | Not available | Each order shows a promised delivery date at checkout. That date is the commitment. ## [DEL-2] Delivery fees Standard delivery is free on orders of ₹499 or more; below that a ₹40 fee applies. Express delivery costs ₹79 and is free for ZentroMart Plus members. ## [DEL-3] Delivery attempts The courier makes up to 3 delivery attempts. After a failed attempt the customer gets an SMS to reschedule. If the third attempt fails, the parcel is returned to the warehouse (return to origin, RTO) and REF-1 applies. ## [DEL-4] Late deliveries If an **Express** order arrives

the customer gets an SMS to reschedule. If the third attempt fails, the parcel is returned to the warehouse (return to origin, RTO) and REF-1 applies. ## [DEL-4] Late deliveries If an **Express** order arrives after its promised date, the ₹79 express fee the customer paid is credited to ZentroMart Wallet automatically within 48 hours. ZentroMart Plus members, who pay no express fee, get no credit. There is no compensation for late Standard deliveries. Agents must not offer any other compensation. ## [DEL-5] Where we deliver ZentroMart delivers only within India, to pincodes listed as serviceable in the pincode table. Cash on delivery and Express are available only where the pincode table says so (`cod_available`, `express_available`). Not every metro pincode has Express. ## [DEL-6] Changing the address The delivery address can be changed before the order ships. After shipping, the address cannot be changed.

--- doc_id: POL-MKT title: Marketplace sellers doc_type: policy audience: customer language: en version: 1.0 effective_from: 2026-03-01 status: current --- # Marketplace sellers ## [MKS-1] Who ships your order Each product in the catalog has a `fulfilled_by` field. Items are either fulfilled by ZentroMart or by an independent marketplace seller. ## [MKS-2] Returns and refunds Return windows, reverse pickup and refunds are the same for every seller and are handled by ZentroMart. ## [MKS-3] Warranty ZentroMart Assured never applies to marketplace seller items, even if the listing says assured. Seller items carry only the brand warranty.

--- doc_id: POL-PAY title: Payments and cash on delivery doc_type: policy audience: customer language: en version: 1.6 effective_from: 2026-04-01 status: current --- # Payments and cash on delivery ## [PAY-1] Payment methods UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, ZentroMart Wallet and cash on delivery (COD). ## [PAY-2] Cash on delivery COD is available on orders up to ₹10,000, only on pincodes where COD is enabled. A COD fee of ₹25 applies per order. ## [PAY-3] Failed payments If money was deducted but the order was not placed, the amount is reversed automatically by the payment provider within 5 business days. No ticket is needed before that. ## [PAY-4] ZentroMart Wallet ZentroMart Wallet balance can be used on any order and never expires. It cannot be transferred to a bank account. For cash-on-delivery refunds, the customer chooses Wallet or bank transfer before the refund is made (REF-3); once refunded to the Wallet, it stays there.

--- doc_id: POL-PLS title: ZentroMart Plus membership doc_type: policy audience: customer language: en version: 1.0 effective_from: 2026-01-01 status: current --- # ZentroMart Plus membership ## [PLS-1] Price ZentroMart Plus costs ₹999 a year. ## [PLS-2] Benefits - Free Express delivery where Express is available. - No reverse pickup fee on any return. - Refunds on returns are initiated at pickup, without waiting for quality check. ZentroMart Plus does **not** change return windows, return eligibility or refund timelines after initiation. ## [PLS-3] Cancelling membership Membership can be cancelled within 14 days of purchase for a full refund if no benefit has been used.

--- doc_id: POL-REF title: Refunds policy doc_type: policy audience: customer language: en version: 2.1 effective_from: 2026-06-15 status: current --- # Refunds policy ## [REF-1] When a refund is initiated - **Cancelled before shipping:** immediately on cancellation. - **Returned item:** after the item passes quality check, within 2 business days of pickup. ZentroMart Plus members: at pickup. - **Prepaid order refused at the door or not delivered after 3 attempts:** once the parcel reaches the warehouse, usually 7 to 10 calendar days after the last delivery attempt. ## [REF-2] How long refunds take after initiation Refunds go back to the original payment method. Timelines are counted in business days from the day the refund is initiated. | Payment method | Time to reach you | | --- | --- | | UPI | 1 to 3 business days | | Credit or debit card | 5 to 7 business days | | Net banking | 3 to 5 business days | | ZentroMart Wallet | Instant, within 2 hours | | Bank transfer (NEFT) for cash-on-delivery orders | 5 to 7

to 7 business days | | Net banking | 3 to 5 business days | | ZentroMart Wallet | Instant, within 2 hours | | Bank transfer (NEFT) for cash-on-delivery orders | 5 to 7 business days | | ZentroMart Wallet for cash-on-delivery orders | Instant, within 2 hours | ## [REF-3] Cash-on-delivery refunds For cash-on-delivery orders, the customer chooses either ZentroMart Wallet (instant) or a bank transfer. Bank transfers start only after the bank account details are verified, then take 5 to 7 business days. ## [REF-4] Partial refunds and coupons If part of an order is returned, the refund is the price paid for that item after its share of any coupon discount. If the remaining order falls below the coupon's minimum order value, the coupon discount on the remaining items is deducted from the refund. ## [REF-5] Delivery and COD fees Delivery fees and the ₹25 cash-on-delivery fee are refunded only when the whole order is cancelled before shipping or returned because it was damaged, defective or wrong. ## [REF-6] Refund reference number Every initiated refund has

--- doc_id: POL-RET title: Returns policy doc_type: policy audience: customer language: en version: 4.0 effective_from: 2026-08-01 status: current supersedes: POL-RET-v3 --- # Returns policy (version 4) ## [RET-1] Scope This policy covers items bought on ZentroMart, whether shipped by ZentroMart or by a marketplace seller. Seller-specific warranty terms are in the Marketplace sellers policy, but return windows are the same for every seller. ## [RET-2] Return windows by category The return window starts on the **delivery date** and is counted in calendar days. | | Beauty and personal care (unopened, seal intact) | 7 days | `beauty_sealed` | | Books and stationery | 10 days | `books_media` | | Grocery, fresh and perishables | Not returnable | `grocery` | | Innerwear, lingerie and swimwear | Not returnable | `innerwear` | | Gift cards and digital codes | Not returnable | `digital` | ## [RET-3] Change to electronics returns From **1 August 2026**, the return window for electronics and accessories is 7 days. Electronics **delivered before 1 August 2026** keep the earlier 10-day window from version 3 of this policy. ## [RET-4] Condition of returned items Items must be unused, with original tags, packaging, accessories and free gifts. Beauty and personal care products are returnable only if unopened with the seal intact. Electronics must not be physically damaged, and any screen lock or account lock must be removed. ## [RET-5] Items that cannot be returned Grocery and fresh produce, innerwear, lingerie and swimwear, and gift cards or digital codes cannot be returned for change of mind. If such an item arrives damaged, expired, wrong

[RET-5] Items that cannot be returned Grocery and fresh produce, innerwear, lingerie and swimwear, and gift cards or digital codes cannot be returned for change of mind. If such an item arrives damaged, expired, wrong or missing, follow the Damaged, wrong or missing items policy. ## [RET-6] Reverse pickup and fees Returns are collected from the delivery address through reverse pickup. A reverse pickup fee of ₹49 applies to change-of-mind returns of clothing, footwear and bags. The fee is waived for ZentroMart Plus members and for any item returned because it was damaged, defective or wrong. ## [RET-7] After pickup Returned items go through a quality check (QC) at the warehouse. The refund is initiated within 2 business days of pickup once the item passes QC. For ZentroMart Plus members, the refund is initiated at the time of pickup. Refund timelines after initiation are in the Refunds policy. ## [RET-8] Festive sale returns Clothing, footwear and bags from orders **placed between 01 October and 15 October 2026** can be returned within 30 days of delivery. All other categories follow the

the Refunds policy. ## [RET-8] Festive sale returns Clothing, footwear and bags from orders **placed between 01 October and 15 October 2026** can be returned within 30 days of delivery. All other categories follow the normal windows in RET-2. ## [RET-9] Exchanges Exchanges for a different size or colour are available on clothing and footwear within the return window, subject to stock. If the new size is out of stock, a return and refund is offered instead.

--- doc_id: POL-WAR title: Warranty and ZentroMart Assured doc_type: policy audience: customer language: en version: 1.1 effective_from: 2026-02-01 status: current --- # Warranty and ZentroMart Assured ## [WAR-1] Brand warranty Most electronics come with the manufacturer's warranty. The warranty period is listed in the `warranty_months` column of the product catalog. Brand warranty claims are made with the manufacturer's service centre. ## [WAR-2] ZentroMart Assured Products marked `assured = true` in the catalog carry a 12-month ZentroMart Assured warranty from the delivery date, in addition to any brand warranty. Claims are raised in the app under My Orders, and ZentroMart arranges pickup and repair or replacement. ## [WAR-3] What warranty does not cover Physical damage, liquid damage, normal wear and unauthorised repairs are not covered.
